remarks: Welcome to Mallard's Landing, where peaceful, park-like surroundings meet everyday convenience. This spacious 2 bedroom, 2 full bath first-floor condo offers 1,196 sq ft of single-level living with no stairs, an open layout, in-unit laundry, and thoughtful touches throughout. The remodeled kitchen, with solid cherry wood cabinetry, granite countertops and Jenn-Air appliances, features a breakfast bar and opens effortlessly to the dining area, complete with a built-in beverage cooler, ideal for entertaining. Two sliding glass doors fill the living space with natural light and lead to a large deck, extending your living outdoors. The primary bedroom features a remodeled bathroom including radiant floor heating, and an Elfa closet system in the large primary closet. Tucked into a quiet community yet minutes from everything, you'll enjoy easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and a list of local amenities, including the newly opened Target and Wegmans, plus Costco, Home Depot, and more. You're also a short drive to both the SoNo and Darien train stations, making commuting a breeze. Enjoy the community pool, beautifully landscaped grounds, and the ease of condo living, all in one of Norwalk's most convenient locations. Make your move to Mallard's Landing and experience low-maintenance living without compromise, the perfect blend of comfort, space, and accessibility.
